summary: Read-only adversarial review accepted, no blocking change recommended. The report-seed-20261030 artifact has all 13 named browser probes passing. Real Go WASM exercises lifecycle, swaps, state/messages, and stale controls; fake runtimes are limited to the runtime error sentinel, exact post-unmount dispatch counting, and malformed/unsupported React snapshots. The expected window.error sentinel is exact and scoped, unexpected or missing manifests fail, unrelated page/console errors remain fatal, and cleanup restores listeners/console state. Detached controls after swap/unmount do not dispatch; malformed initial mounts do not leave createRoot warnings; invalid post-dispatch snapshots preserve the last valid renderer snapshot and stop further callbacks.
